key_insight: Fine-tuning a pretrained order-flow model enables competitive sub-second microprice forecasting, although this paper concerns financial markets rather than materials science.
engineering_relevance: The forecasts could support execution and market-making systems, where small price movements can inform order placement.
method: Pretrain a 300M-parameter autoregressive generative model on Level-3 order-flow data.
Fine-tune it to predict microprice returns and realized volatility.
Compare return forecasts with classical baselines and test zero-shot transfer to unseen assets.
evidence_signal: Using Bitstamp and Bitfinex data, the authors report better sub-second return predictions than classical baselines, including gradient boosting on handcrafted features, and zero-shot transfer to assets excluded from fine-tuning.
watch_item: Predicted price moves are smaller than the bid–ask spread plus fees, limiting direct trading profitability.
paper_title: Fine-Tuning an Order-Flow Foundation Model for Sub-Second Forecasting
